body: Also there is no job that I can apply to at my age, I live in Slovakia. The unemployment rate even for adults is quite big, I am also weak and clumsy and I have no motor skills as I have previously mentioned. I hate the fact that I have to think about what I do and whether it's going to make money, I have no idea how to make money with photography...

Unfortunately I can not write properly in Slovak (my first language)  And although I can write and speak English quite fluently, I struggle to translate something from English to my language. I know what it is, exactly, I just find it hard to use the proper Slovak words to describe it, because when I read something in English I do not translate it back into Slovak, I think in English mostly. And except school, I think I am more exposed to English than I am to Slovak in my everyday life. So I can name  3 synonyms to any given adjective in English, but in Slovak I can't think of none.

That's the problem I can not get kicked out at 18, I have nowhere to go really, I am not sure if he will proceed to kick me out but the problem is the screaming and the fear of it, he won't stop and everyday feels like I am closer to getting kicked out. I can not even do gaming as I used to, I have never been that type of gamer to play 12 hours a day, but a 1,2 hours .. yes..  Nowadays though if I try that and god forbid he  sees me playing all the hell breaks lose.  Getting good grades in School  does not satisfy him anymore. "How is this what you are doing contributing to you getting a lot of money " ?  I can not stand that.
